006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter.MetaschemaDataTypeProvider;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.InvalidValueForCastFunctionException;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.impl.QNameItemImpl;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IAtomicOrUnionType;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.InvalidTypeMetapathException;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.qname.EQNameFactory;
014import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
015
016import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
017
018/**
019 * An atomic Metapath item with a namespace qualified name value.
020 */
021public interface IQNameItem extends IAnyAtomicItem {
022  /**
023   * Get the type information for this item.
024   *
025   * @return the type information
026   */
027  @NonNull
028  static IAtomicOrUnionType<IQNameItem> type() {
029    return MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.QNAME.getItemType();
030  }
031
032  @Override
033  default IAtomicOrUnionType<IQNameItem> getType() {
034    return type();
035  }
036
037  /**
038   * Construct a new QName item using the provided string {@code value}.
039   *
040   * @param value
041   *          a string representing a QName value
042   * @return the new item
043   */
044  // TODO: Review metaschema-framework/metaschema-java#396 and change accordingly.
045  @NonNull
046  static IQNameItem valueOf(@NonNull String value) {
047    return valueOf(EQNameFactory.instance().parseUriQualifiedName(value));
048  }
049
050  /**
051   * Construct a new QName item using the provided {@code value}.
052   *
053   * @param value
054   *          a QName
055   * @return the new item
056   */
057  @NonNull
058  static IQNameItem valueOf(@NonNull IEnhancedQName value) {
059    return new QNameItemImpl(value);
060  }
061
062  /**
063   * Cast the provided type to this item type.
064   *
065   * @param item
066   *          the item to cast
067   * @return the original item if it is already this type, otherwise a new item
068   *         cast to this type
069   * @throws InvalidValueForCastFunctionException
070   *           if the provided {@code item} cannot be cast to this type
071   */
072  @NonNull
073  static IQNameItem cast(@NonNull IAnyAtomicItem item) {
074    try {
075      return item instanceof IQNameItem
076          ? (IQNameItem) item
077          : valueOf(item.asString());
078    } catch (IllegalStateException | InvalidTypeMetapathException ex) {
079      // asString can throw IllegalStateException exception
080      throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(ex);
081    }
082  }
083
084  @Override
085  default IQNameItem castAsType(IAnyAtomicItem item) {
086    return cast(item);
087  }
088
089  /**
090   * Get the "wrapped" EnhancedQName value.
091   *
092   * @return the underlying QName value
093   */
094  @NonNull
095  IEnhancedQName toEnhancedQName();
096
097  /**
098   * Compares this value with the argument.
099   *
100   * @param item
101   *          the item to compare with this value
102   * @return a negative integer, zero, or a positive integer if this value is less
103   *         than, equal to, or greater than the {@code item}.
104   */
105  default int compareTo(@NonNull IQNameItem item) {
106    return toEnhancedQName().compareTo(item.toEnhancedQName());
107  }
108}
